# ScriptClientPlayer

*Client* · extends [`ScriptClientEntity`](/scripting/client/entity/ScriptClientEntity)

Controls the local client player, including microphone and individually heard voice effects. Voice settings remain configurable without Simple Voice Chat; PCM effects run only on this client.

## Methods

### getMinecraftPlayer {#getminecraftplayer}

::: member

**Returns** `ClientPlayerEntity` — the Minecraft client player, for Java code

:::

### setKeybindCombo {#setkeybindcombo}

::: member

Assigns a personal keyboard combination to a Scram keybind on this client and sends it to the server for saving. Saved in this world's player data and retained after reconnecting and respawning. Shared triggers stay unchanged. Unknown IDs remain inactive until the keybind exists. Run on the client thread with this player still current.

```js
c.getPlayer().setKeybindCombo("dash", 341, 71); // Left Ctrl + G
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keybind ID, nonblank, at most 128 characters |
| `keys` | `int[]` | GLFW keyboard codes (32..348), at most 16; empty disables the binding for this player |

:::

### getKeybindCombo {#getkeybindcombo}

::: member

Returns this player's effective combination, inheriting the shared keybind unless overridden.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keybind ID, nonblank, at most 128 characters |

**Returns** `int[]` — independent GLFW keyboard-code array; empty when no keys are assigned

:::

### resetKeybindCombo {#resetkeybindcombo}

::: member

Removes this player's saved override and restores the shared combination, including future catalog changes. Sends the reset to the server for saving.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keybind ID, nonblank, at most 128 characters |

:::

### hasLicense {#haslicense}

::: member

Checks whether this client is signed in with a licensed Microsoft account. Uses the result of the access token check that Minecraft performs against Mojang services at startup, so the call makes no network requests. Returns false for offline (cracked) accounts, development sessions and expired or forged tokens. Also returns false for a licensed account if Mojang services were unreachable when the game started. The result is computed on this client, so a modified client can fake it; servers that must trust it should use online mode instead.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the session is a Microsoft account whose access token Mojang services accepted

:::

### setForm {#setform}

::: member

Sets the player's form on this client only; the server and other players keep the old one, and the next form from the server replaces it. Use the server's `setForm` to change it for everybody.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scriptForm` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to copy, not null |

:::

### setForm {#setform-2}

::: member

Sets the form seen in first person, or, with `false`, the player's form as [`setForm(BBSForm)`](#setform) does.

The first-person form stands on the player like a morph that only shows in first person: at the player's feet with no offset, turned with the body and animated by what the player does (walking, swinging, looking around), so looking down shows the body, as the First Person Model mod does. The usual first-person arms are hidden meanwhile (hand forms from `getHand(..).setForm` still show); held items stay. The form is drawn where the camera is, so leave its head out or hide it, or it covers the view. Only this client sees it, the third-person view keeps the player's form, and it is saved with the client data of the player.

```js
c.getPlayer().setForm(true, scram.form('{"id":"bbs:model","model":"my_body"}'));
c.getPlayer().setForm(true, null); // usual first-person view
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isFirstPerson` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true for the first-person form, false for the player's form |
| `scriptForm` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to copy; `null` removes the first-person form, and is not allowed for the player's form |

:::

### getForm {#getform-2}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isFirstPerson` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true for the first-person form, see [`setForm(boolean, BBSForm)`](#setform), false for the player's form as [`getForm()`](#getform) returns it |

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — the form; changes to it show at once; the first-person form is `null` if none is set

:::

### playAnimation {#playanimation}

::: member

Plays an animation of this player's model form once, only on this client; other players do not see it. Use the server's `ScriptServerPlayer.playAnimation` to show it to everyone. The animation plays over the current actions (idle, walking and so on) and does not loop; playing it again restarts it. Works with forms set by [`setLocalForm(BBSForm)`](#setlocalform) too.

```js
c.getPlayer().playAnimation("wave");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `animation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | animation name from the model file (for example a Blockbench animation), not empty. Names that the model does not have are ignored, as are models that are not loaded yet. |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the player's form is a model form and the animation was played; `false` if the player has no form or it is not a model form

:::

### pressKey {#presskey}

::: member

Presses a key on this client for one tick; see [`pressKey(String, int)`](#presskey).

```js
c.getPlayer().pressKey("space");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keyboard key name from options.txt, with or without the `key.keyboard.` prefix, case-insensitive: `"a"` .. `"z"`, `"0"` .. `"9"`, `"f1"` .. `"f25"`, `"space"`, `"enter"`, `"escape"`, `"tab"`, `"backspace"`, `"left.shift"`, `"left.control"`, `"left.alt"`, `"up"`, `"down"`, `"left"`, `"right"`, `"keypad.1"` and so on. |

:::

### pressKey {#presskey-2}

::: member

Simulates a key press on this client and holds the key for the given number of ticks. The press goes through Minecraft's keyboard handler like a real one: the open screen, vanilla key bindings (jump, inventory, drop, perspective...), other mods and Scram keybinds react to it. Code that reads the physical keyboard directly does not see it, so a held Shift or Ctrl does not act as a modifier for other keys. The key is released after `ticks` client ticks, or when the player leaves the world; pressing a held key presses it again.

```js
c.getPlayer().pressKey("w", 40);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keyboard key name from options.txt, with or without the `key.keyboard.` prefix, case-insensitive: `"a"` .. `"z"`, `"0"` .. `"9"`, `"f1"` .. `"f25"`, `"space"`, `"enter"`, `"escape"`, `"tab"`, `"backspace"`, `"left.shift"`, `"left.control"`, `"left.alt"`, `"up"`, `"down"`, `"left"`, `"right"`, `"keypad.1"` and so on. |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | client ticks to hold the key, from 1 to 12000 (10 minutes) |

:::

### setLocalForm {#setlocalform}

::: member

Forces a form on the player that only this client sees, every tick, until [`disableLocalForm()`](#disablelocalform); forms from the server are overridden meanwhile. It is saved with the client data of the player.

```js
c.getPlayer().setLocalForm(scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}'));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bbsForm` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to force, not null; used as is, so later changes to it show too |

:::

### getLocalForm {#getlocalform}

::: member

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — the forced local form, see [`setLocalForm`](#setlocalform); its wrapper holds no form if none is forced

:::

### disableLocalForm {#disablelocalform}

::: member

Stops forcing the local form; the player keeps showing it until the next form comes from the server.

:::

### openGUI {#opengui}

::: member

Opens a Minecraft screen, replacing the open one, as if the player opened it. Screens with a back button return to the screen that was open before.

```js
c.getPlayer().openGUI("inventory");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | screen ID: `"inventory"` (creative inventory in creative mode), `"chat"`, `"command"` (chat starting with /), `"pause"`, `"options"`, `"controls"`, `"keybinds"`, `"mouse"`, `"video"`, `"sound"`, `"language"`, `"chat_options"`, `"skin"`, `"accessibility"`, `"advancements"`, `"stats"` or `"social"` (player interactions) |

:::

### closeGUI {#closegui}

::: member

Closes the open screen, including chests and other containers, and returns the player to the game. Does nothing if no screen is open.

```js
c.getPlayer().closeGUI();
```

:::

### getSetting {#getsetting}

::: member

Returns a client setting: a Minecraft option, a key binding or a BBS/Scram setting.

```js
var fov = c.getPlayer().getSetting("fov");                 // 70
var jump = c.getPlayer().getSetting("key.jump");           // "key.keyboard.space"
var graphics = c.getPlayer().getSetting("graphicsMode");   // "fancy"
var autocomplete = c.getPlayer().getSetting("scram.scripts.autocomplete"); // true
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | setting ID, checked in this order: a key binding of Minecraft or a mod by its translation key (`"key.jump"`, `"key.inventory"`; options.txt form `"key_key.jump"` works too); a Minecraft option by its options.txt key (`"fov"`, `"gamma"`, `"renderDistance"`, `"guiScale"`, `"mouseSensitivity"`, `"graphicsMode"`, `"soundCategory_master"`, `"modelPart_cape"` ...); a BBS or Scram setting by its path `"module.category.value"` (`"scram.scripts.autocomplete"`, `"bbs.editor.duration"`) |

**Returns** `Any` — a number, boolean or string. Options with fixed choices return the choice in lower case (`"fancy"`), key bindings return the bound key (`"key.keyboard.space"`, `"key.mouse.left"`, `"key.keyboard.unknown"` when unbound), BBS settings that hold structured data return it as a JSON-like string

:::

### setSetting {#setsetting}

::: member

Changes a client setting and saves it, as if the player changed it in the settings screens: the change applies immediately and persists after restart. A few options that Minecraft reads only on startup or resource reload, such as `"lang"` and `"resourcePacks"`, take effect only then.

```js
c.getPlayer().setSetting("fov", 90);
c.getPlayer().setSetting("graphicsMode", "fast");
c.getPlayer().setSetting("key.jump", "r");          // rebinds jump to R; "mouse.right" or "none" also work
c.getPlayer().setSetting("scram.scripts.autocomplete", false);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | setting ID, checked in this order: a key binding of Minecraft or a mod by its translation key (`"key.jump"`, `"key.inventory"`; options.txt form `"key_key.jump"` works too); a Minecraft option by its options.txt key (`"fov"`, `"gamma"`, `"renderDistance"`, `"guiScale"`, `"mouseSensitivity"`, `"graphicsMode"`, `"soundCategory_master"`, `"modelPart_cape"` ...); a BBS or Scram setting by its path `"module.category.value"` (`"scram.scripts.autocomplete"`, `"bbs.editor.duration"`) |
| `value` | `Any` | new value of the setting's type: numbers are checked against the option's range (Minecraft options) or clamped to it (BBS settings); fixed choices accept their name in any case or their number; key bindings accept a key name like `"space"`, `"left.shift"`, `"key.keyboard.r"`, `"mouse.left"` or `"none"` to unbind; structured BBS settings accept a JSON-like string in the format [`getSetting(String)`](#getsetting) returns |

:::

### getMinecraftHud {#getminecrafthud}

::: member

Returns an element of the vanilla Minecraft HUD to move, resize or hide it for this player. Changes stay until reset or until the player leaves the world.

```js
var player = c.getPlayer();

player.getMinecraftHud("hotbar").setPosition(0, -20);
player.getMinecraftHud("chat").setScale(0.75);
player.getMinecraftHud("food").setRender(false);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | element ID: `"hotbar"`, `"crosshair"`, `"boss_bar"`, `"armor"`, `"health"`, `"food"`, `"air"`, `"mount_health"`, `"jump_bar"`, `"experience"`, `"held_item"` (name of the selected item), `"status_effects"`, `"subtitles"`, `"sidebar"` (scoreboard), `"chat"`, `"player_list"` (Tab list), `"action_bar"` or `"title"` (title and subtitle). Moving or scaling the chat does not move the click areas of its links |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientHud`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientHud) — the element; every call with the same ID changes the same element

:::

### getMinecraftHudIds {#getminecrafthudids}

::: member

**Returns** `List<String>` — IDs accepted by [`getMinecraftHud(String)`](#getminecrafthud).

:::

### takeScreenshot {#takescreenshot}

::: member

Saves the next completed client frame, including HUD and screens, through BBS ScreenshotRecorder, under a unique name capture-UUID.png. Call on the Minecraft client thread. Encoding runs asynchronously; upload starts after the PNG is fully written. Local files are saved in config/scram/screenshots and appear in the BBS texture picker under the screenshots source, e.g. screenshots:capture-UUID.png. Server uploads are limited to 512 MiB per file. Successful saving/upload and asynchronous failures are reported only in the log. Screenshots are captured at most once per rendered frame and encoded as lossless PNG.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sendToServer` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true to also save a copy on the connected Scram server, false to keep it locally |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the absolute local PNG path; the file may still be encoding

:::

### takeScreenshot {#takescreenshot-2}

::: member

Same as [`takeScreenshot(boolean)`](#takescreenshot), but saves the PNG as config/scram/screenshots/name.png, available as the BBS texture screenshots:name.png. An existing screenshot with this name is replaced once the new image is fully written, and BBS reloads the texture.

```js
c.getPlayer().takeScreenshot("portrait", false); // screenshots:portrait.png
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | file name of 1-124 characters: ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit; the ".png" suffix is optional and added when missing. Windows device names such as "con" are rejected. |
| `sendToServer` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true to also save a copy on the connected Scram server, false to keep it locally |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the absolute local PNG path; the file may still be encoding

:::

### isVoiceChatAvailable {#isvoicechatavailable}

::: member

Checks whether Simple Voice Chat is installed and this client's voice connection is active.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if voice chat is available on this client

:::

### getVoiceEqualizer {#getvoiceequalizer}

::: member

Gets this client's outgoing microphone equalizer, pitch and distortion, before Opus encoding. All listeners hear these effects. Local settings are not sent to the server; a later server equalizer update replaces this equalizer's settings, preserving local reverb. Call on the Minecraft client thread.

**Returns** [`VoiceServerEqualizer`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerEqualizer) — the shared local microphone equalizer, never null

:::

### getVoiceReverb {#getvoicereverb}

::: member

Gets this client's outgoing microphone reverb, after equalization and before Opus encoding. The same synchronization and thread rules as [`getVoiceEqualizer()`](#getvoiceequalizer) apply.

**Returns** [`VoiceServerReverb`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerReverb) — the shared local microphone reverberator, never null

:::

### getVoiceEqualizer {#getvoiceequalizer-2}

::: member

Gets an equalizer for one speaker's decoded voice, heard only on this client. The speaker need not be loaded in the client world, so distant group members work too. These settings add to that speaker's microphone effects. Call on the client thread. Settings are shared by speaker UUID and cleared on Minecraft disconnect or server reset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speakerId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | the speaker's UUID string, not null |

**Returns** [`VoiceServerEqualizer`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerEqualizer) — the shared local equalizer for that speaker, never null

:::

### getVoiceReverb {#getvoicereverb-2}

::: member

Gets reverb for one speaker's decoded voice, after their local equalizer. The same synchronization and lifecycle rules as [`getVoiceEqualizer(String)`](#getvoiceequalizer) apply.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speakerId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | the speaker's UUID string, not null |

**Returns** [`VoiceServerReverb`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerReverb) — the shared local reverberator for that speaker, never null

:::
